binding_status.description: Whether the operator has confirmed the binding or it is still a candidate

coordinate_key.description: The override discriminator carried in the fact identity: empty for the default binding, else an 8-hex hash of the coordinate selector

doc_type.description: Null on this shelf — the general opportunity home. A doc-type-scoped location is a **separate** shelf (`document_location:opportunity:{doc_type}`)

entity_type.description: The entity kind whose documents this binding locates; on this shelf the key fixes it to `opportunity`

source_system.description: The producing system of the fact; `AUTHORED` when the location is entered in Demiton rather than harvested.

sources.description: The ordered list of places to look for this opportunity's documents; each element is one complete declarative locator

sources[].connector_ref.description: The logical alias of the connector that reaches this source — the only identity a source carries besides raw store coordinates

sources[].doc_subpath.description: An optional fixed sub-path inside the opportunity folder where this doc type's files sit; unused by the observed general binding

sources[].entity_folder_pattern.description: How each opportunity's own folder is named, binding a folder to the entity by its number token

sources[].file_glob.description: The file match for this doc type: `*` (no filter) or a single `*.ext` glob; unused by the observed general binding

sources[].folder_pattern.description: A case-insensitive regex matched against folder names at any depth, used where no single sub-path name holds across opportunities; unused by the observed general binding

sources[].lifecycle_folders.description: The status-tagged folders to traverse; the opportunity's documents live in the folder matching its current status, and the folder moves as it progresses

sources[].root_folder.description: Path under the store root to start from; empty/null for site+drive systems

sources[].store_drive_name.description: The drive's display name; used to translate between the store root and the display paths the agents' manifests use

sources[].store_site_id.description: The store's site identifier; required to reach a source on site-addressed systems

sources[].store_site_label.description: Operator-facing display name for the site; copied forward with the store block, consumed by no automated reader

sources[].system.description: The storage system of one source; only `SHAREPOINT` and `DROPBOX` are crawlable
